about: CE-L12D007-02 directory-link rows (added by the Rust closure review, minion-agent#199 issuecomment-6111409107, finding L12D007-R001): a DIRECTORY LINK child (directory symlink; junction, Windows only) entering Windows fixWinEPERM recovery. Recovery's following stat finds a directory, so rmdir is applied to the link itself; the link target and its content must survive. Run with ce02-recovery-pi-probe.mjs / ce02_recovery_py_probe.py (third argument); junction rows are skipped off Windows. Same rows as the Rust crate's ce02-data/dirlink-matrix.json.
